_about: PCB stack-up profiles. Each entry defines the physical layer arrangement: which copper layers exist, their thickness, the dielectric between them, and the target single-ended (Z0) and differential (Zdiff) impedance. Values feed the `(stackup …)` block inside .kicad_pcb and the `diff_pair_dimensions` array in .kicad_pro. Pure data — adding a new stack-up means appending an entry, no Python change.
_units: all thicknesses in mm. Z0 / Zdiff in ohms. epsilon_r is the relative permittivity (Dk) of the dielectric.
_layer_naming: KiCad canonical layer names: F.Cu, B.Cu (signal); In1.Cu, In2.Cu, … (internal copper). Power/ground designation lives in `role` (signal|ground|power|mixed).

two_layer_1mm6._comment: Default hobbyist/proto stack-up. Two copper layers, 1.6 mm FR4 core, 1 oz copper. Z0 50 ohm microstrip is impractical here (would need ~3 mm trace) — controlled-impedance work needs 4-layer.
two_layer_1mm6.name: 2-layer 1.6 mm FR4

target_impedance._comment: 2-layer w/ 1.51 mm dielectric — single-ended 50 ohm needs ~3 mm trace, impractical. Diff 100 ohm needs >>2 mm gap. Use 4-layer for controlled impedance.
target_impedance._caveat: Calculated but NOT recommended on 2-layer. The single-ended value is an order of magnitude wider than typical signal traces — sign that the geometry doesn't support clean 50 ohm. Promote to 4-layer for any net needing controlled Z.

four_layer_1mm6._comment: Industry default for any board with high-speed signals (USB, Ethernet, HDMI, anything >50 MHz). Sig / GND / PWR / Sig sandwich. Thin prepreg under F.Cu and above B.Cu gives microstrip impedance reachable at sane trace widths.
four_layer_1mm6.name: 4-layer 1.6 mm FR4 (Sig/GND/PWR/Sig)

target_impedance._caveat: Computed for outer-layer microstrip referenced to In1.Cu (ground), 0.21 mm prepreg, Dk=4.3 — typical KiCad calculator output. Always re-verify with the actual fab's stack-up before tape-out.

six_layer_1mm6._comment: Six-copper-layer 1.6 mm stack — sig/gnd/sig/sig/pwr/sig. Adds a second internal signal pair for dense BGAs while keeping every signal layer adjacent to a reference plane.
six_layer_1mm6.name: 6-layer 1.6 mm FR4 (Sig/GND/Sig/Sig/PWR/Sig)

target_impedance._caveat: Outer microstrip referenced to In1/In4 (ground/power). Internal stripline impedance differs — recompute per-layer with the fab's actual stack.

auto_select._comment: Heuristic rules the architect / set_design_rules tool uses to pick a stack-up automatically when the user doesn't name one. Order matters — first match wins. Pure data; the tool just iterates these rules and reads the named profile from `profiles`.
